install.title: Install Poruch as an app
install.why: Poruch works best as an app on your home screen.
benefits: 🔔 Notifications arrive even when the app is closed
⚡ Opens with one tap, full screen
📍 Finds you and people nearby faster

ios: Tap Share ⬆️ — at the bottom of the screen or in the “⋯” menu
Tap “Add” — Poruch appears with your apps
ios-other-browser: Tap Share ⬆️ in the address bar
Choose “Add to Home Screen”; if it's missing, open the site in Safari
in-app: This app opened the site in its built-in browser, which can't install apps
Tap “⋯” or “⋮” at the top, choose “Open in browser” (Safari or Chrome) and install Poruch there
android: Open the browser menu ⋮ in the top right
Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”
Confirm — Poruch appears with your apps
desktop: Click the install icon ⊕ in the address bar (or menu ⋮ → “Install Poruch”)

ios: The site must be open in the Safari app. Telegram, Instagram and others open pages in a built-in viewer that can't install apps. Copy the address (button below) and paste it into Safari.
How to check you're in Safari: the Share menu has “Add Bookmark” and “Find on Page”.
No “Add to Home Screen” in Safari? Scroll the Share menu to “Edit Actions…” and turn it on.
Turn off Safari Private Browsing (dark address bar).
ios-other-browser: If the Share menu has no “Add to Home Screen”, open the site in Safari: copy the address below and paste it there.
A page opened from Telegram or Instagram is a built-in viewer and can't install apps.
iOS 16.4 or later is required: Settings → General → About.
in-app: Copy the address with the button below and paste it into Safari (iPhone) or Chrome (Android).
android: The site must be open in Chrome. In Telegram, Instagram and other apps tap ⋮ → “Open in Chrome”.
No “Install app” item? Update Chrome in Google Play, or copy the address below and open it in Chrome.
desktop: Chrome and Edge support installing. In Safari on Mac: File → Add to Dock.
Firefox can't install apps — open the site in Chrome or Edge.
